Apprehending the arrest at the hands of
 police in connection with Crime N
 registered with Police Station Pinjar, Tq. Barshitakli,
 District Akola for the offence punishable under
Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal
 Code, the applicant approached to this Court for grant
 of pre arrest bail.
2.  As per the allegations, the father of the  informant has received the said property from  Government, after retirement from the service of  Army.

On the basis of false and fabricated documents,
 the present applicant impersonated the original owner  and played a role in selling of the said property and  thereafter, the informant was duped.
On the basis of  the said report, police have registered the crime.

3. Heard learned Counsel for the applicant, who  submitted that the only role attributed to the present  applicant that he stood as a witness to the said  2   transaction and, therefore, his custodial in  is not required.
He is implicated falsely by  accused.
In view of that the applicant be pr  granting ad-interim anticipatory bail.
